title: Why ChatGPT Might Be Ignoring Your Business
description:
Your business may have an excellent reputation and still be almost invisible to AI search.

A dedicated, indexable page for reviews, testimonials, case studies, and success stories gives search engines—and potentially AI tools—another clear source of context about your company.

The key is discoverability: make the page useful, public, and linked from your main website.
